Title: A Tiny Hi on the Desert Path

Duration: 15 seconds

Format: 16:9 horizontal

Cinematic Style: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook animation matching the current Magic English Voyage art direction, adapted for the desert map. Warm cream sunlight, soft sand and clay earth tones, pale mint-green oasis plants, tiny coral-pink accents, soft pencil outlines, visible paper grain, low-saturation colors, gentle imperfect brush texture, cozy quiet emotion. Characters should look warm, clean, attractive, and child-safe: bright clean eyes, soft cheeks, balanced proportions, gentle smiles, refined hand-painted character design. It must feel hand-drawn and alive, not glossy 3D or plastic CGI.

Source Situation: Two young children meet again on a quiet desert-oasis path. One child gives a smaller, softer greeting: "Hi." The other child smiles and answers. The meaning of the English expression "Hi" must be visually clear through a casual small wave, eye contact, and friendly greeting. No classroom, no flashcards, no written labels.

CEFR Target: Pre-A1 / very young A1. The target English expression is "Hi". Keep every spoken line short, natural, and easy for a young English learner to understand. The word "Hi" must be heard clearly several times, but it should sound like real friendly greeting, not a vocabulary drill.
